base_commit_semantics: Inspected F01 evidence/source baseline. Before live activation, pin the actual master F01 acceptance commit (documentation-only descendant). Start from the branch commit containing activation and preserve its controls. This proposal alone authorizes no worker writes.
dependencies: F01 code acceptance recorded by master with independent platform gaps retained
No other active feature writer; recheck remote assignment/branch and host writer status
Preserve the complete current source, F01 palette, native capture and OS boundaries

path_constraints.spatial-source/web/src/surfacePalette.ts: Only explicit opening-material handling required by shared batching/GLB; preserve accepted F01 structural colors and selection contrast.
path_constraints.spatial-source/web/src/ui/roomDrawing.ts: Version-aware preflight only; preserve drawing and snap behavior.
path_constraints.spatial-source/web/src/ui/wallDrawing.ts: Version-aware preflight only; preserve drawing and snap behavior.
path_constraints.spatial-source/web/src/ui/workspace.css: Opening controls, handles, catalog and compact Details elevation only; no page redesign.
path_constraints.spatial-source/contracts/COMPATIBILITY.m: Document delegated D11-D13 format/admission behavior; no change to disabled publisher or old schemas.
path_constraints.new_helpers: core/openings.ts owns catalog capabilities, validation, chart/orientation transforms and diagrammatic primitives. openingModelManipulation.ts owns 3D hit/plane/gesture calculations. OpeningElevation.tsx is the compact Details elevation control.
path_constraints.all_paths: Exact grant, not a requirement to edit every file. Only F02 dependencies; preserve all unrelated behavior and historical evidence.

forbidden_without_master_amendment: Store database/schema migration or source-provenance rewrite
Publishing, signing, installation or business-data binding

focused_acceptance.check: One asymmetric small-screen 3D journey: selection reveals handles, only corners resize with opposite corner fixed; edge translates along host without dimensional change; walkthrough remains navigation-only.
Plan width/body, compact elevation and exact numeric controls share commands and agree on angled/nonzero-elevation hosts, wall.baseY, raised bottoms and preserved finger grab offset.

Parameterized seven-preset capability/geometry coverage; meaningful horizontal/vertical flips; split and reversed-join world-space preservation; reload; one desktop catalog view and representative mobile views.

Bounds/overlap/inversion and rigid bent-host rejection plus legacy generic bent-host continuity. Focused cancellation table: second touch, Escape, lost capture, blur/background, view/selection/context change, authority loss and stale release. Style/flip never unlock inferred apertures.

One gesture/one undo item, redo/reopen/frozen export/import retain geometry/style/orientation/provenance. One browser complete-local-document archive round trip, old 1.0/1.1 admission, unsupported version rejection without mutation, recovery v1/v2, and rejected 1.2 legacy exchange/outbox. Include room/wall/area edits on 1.2 to detect preflight/downgrade regressions.

Door/passage/window navigation restrictions from committed geometry remain intact. Burst pointer samples coalesce without renderer construction, durable writes or full scene rebuild each move; exact release commits once. Reuse relevant warm-idle instrumentation.

build_policy: One final npm run build for the current candidate. Focused changed-risk tests and one combined browser journey; no broad OS/native/offline/stress suites. Reuse matching F01 evidence for unchanged material behavior. Record exact command/input/environment/result.
delivery_boundary: Source implementation and local affected verification only. Master performs accepted-source host transfer/readback/build/served checks and combined Apple/OS delivery. Separate every receipt; do not claim installed parity.

activation_decisions.value: Optional Opening.style is {id,end?,side?,provenance}; style IDs are the seven verified presets, kind and required orientation capabilities are validated. Legacy style remains absent. Style/flip-only commands author nested style provenance and preserve base aperture provenance. Only actual geometry correction follows the existing aperture provenance transition. Cosmetic style must not unlock inferred portals.

Reserve geometry 1.2.0 and scene 1.2.0 after collision check. Add explicit opening face role owned by opening ID. Keep immutable old schemas. Retain local-document 1.0/1.1 and drawing profiles while member/vocabulary contracts stay unchanged; complete geometry/scene remain separately versioned. Reject 1.2 from constrained legacy v1 exchange/outbox with an actionable complete-local-document alternative. Styled drawing recovery uses formatVersion 2 alongside legacy 1. No database version migration solely for this payload.

setArea and scene area branches must never downgrade a higher admitted version. Room/wall/placement preflights preserve the source document version instead of synthesizing only 1.0/1.1. Drawings/export extents include style symbols. New opening emitters explicitly dispatch material roles without changing accepted structural palette.

stop_after: F02 handoff to master; never self-activate F03.
writeback: Commit only assigned paths on current program branch with expected-head/fast-forward protection after rechecking live activation. No force rewrite; if writes blocked return exact patch and honest local-only handoff.
scope_review: Bounded read-only agent inspected current source and relevant consumers, no overlapping writer or product tests; master reviewed its findings.
external_state: Historical serial proposal; do not execute or copy into live controls.
